Name: Holon in Moab
Description: A town named among the plain-country towns of Moab on which judgment is pronounced in Jeremiah 48, listed with Jahazah and Mephaath — a Moabite Holon, distinct from the town of the same name in Judah's hill country.
BiblicalSignificance: Its single appearance is in the oracle against Moab, showing the name Holon belonged to a Moabite town as well as to Judah's.
